title: Detailed snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='globeGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bfe8ff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#7ec8f0' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a9fd4' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='snowGrad' cx='50%' cy='70%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d6ecff'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='26' ry='7' fill='#6b3fa0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='24' ry='6' fill='#9b6fd4'/>
  <rect x='26' y='76' width='48' height='9' rx='3' fill='#b085e8'/>
  <rect x='26' y='76' width='48' height='3' rx='2' fill='#d4b6f5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='77' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#7d4fc0'/>
  <!-- globe glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='31' fill='url(#globeGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='31' fill='none' stroke='#a8dcf5' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- snow ground inside -->
  <path d='M25 65 Q35 58 50 60 Q65 58 75 65 Q70 72 50 72 Q30 72 25 65 Z' fill='url(#snowGrad)'/>
  <!-- little house -->
  <rect x='40' y='50' width='14' height='12' fill='#e85d5d'/>
  <rect x='40' y='50' width='14' height='12' fill='none' stroke='#ff8a8a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <polygon points='37,50 54,50 47,42' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <polygon points='37,50 54,50 47,42' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='44' y='55' width='4' height='7' fill='#7a3d3d'/>
  <rect x='49.5' y='53' width='3' height='3' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- snowman -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='61' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='55' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='55' r='3' fill='none' stroke='#cfe6f7' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='54.5' r='0.5' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='54.5' r='0.5' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <polygon points='64,55.5 66.5,56 64,56.5' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <rect x='61' y='51' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a8fd4'/>
  <!-- pine tree -->
  <rect x='34' y='58' width='2' height='5' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <polygon points='35,46 28,59 42,59' fill='#3f9e63'/>
  <polygon points='35,50 29,59 41,59' fill='#57c07d'/>
  <!-- falling snowflakes -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='22' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='28' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='38' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='50' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='52' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='30' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='44' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='20' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- glossy highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='28' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.35' transform='rotate(-25 38 28)'/>
</svg>
